_doc: Kevin tire profiles: single source of truth (mirrored byte-identical in anglerdroid src/tire_profiles.json and kevin-urdf-twin simready/tire_profiles.json). Selected by robots/<robot>/robot.json "wheels" (env override KEVIN_WHEELS; KEVIN_TIRE = legacy alias, still read by the twin) (twin: also --tire flag / ?tire= URL param). Default soft_v3_2 since 2026-10-21 (James fitted the tyres 2026-10-20; KEVIN_TIRE=stock = old tyres). See docs/tire_profiles.md.

stock.label: ODrive BotWheel stock rubber tire
stock.status: measured (twin geometry); robot_config keeps James's tape value 17.0 cm
stock._tread_note: null: the stock tyre's plan view is inside SIL12 (1.9 mm) -> no extra footprint corners

soft_v3_2.label: KevinFlex soft over-tire v3.2 (95A TPU, 20 spokes)
soft_v3_2._mj_note: v311 (2026-10-21): solref 0.0282 -> axle settles at 0.10066 m, pitch -0.066 deg (stock -0.062) on the twin floor: free R 103.8 (STL) -> loaded 100.65 mm = stock 85.65 + 15 (James), 3.15 mm sink (~15.6 N/mm at ~49 N/wheel). v308 solref 0.0446 settled at 0.0966 on the twin floor (its 0.0999 note was measured with a different floor).
soft_v3_2.status: FITTED 2026-10-20 (James). Loaded R = stock + 15 mm per James (design +14.35 loaded / +18.15 free); caster lowered 15 mm by James (chassis level). Re-measure loaded radius (roll 10 turns: distance / 20 pi) and ride height; friction unmeasured (stock value kept).
soft_v3_2._ripple_note: per-wheel axle-height ripple at n_spokes x wheel angle: +-0.2 mm ESTIMATED (stiffness ripple ~+-6 % of the 3.15 mm sink as the 32 mm spoke pitch passes under a ~50 mm contact patch); unmeasured: REALTEST item measures it. emu: KEVIN_EMU_RIPPLE (m, 0 = off).
soft_v3_2._tread_note: outer tread edge from the axle centre line: wheel frame y 0.1515 + STL tread z 5.2..51.8 mm

_default_note: "default" is read only by the twin's own simready/tire_profile.py when KEVIN_TIRE is unset; the robot code (src/robot_params.py) takes the wheels from robots/<robot>/robot.json (emu.world passes them to the twin via KEVIN_TIRE).
